import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static long inv100;

    static long modPow(long a, long e) {
        long res = 1;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) res = (res * a) % MOD;
            a = (a * a) % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long inv(long a) {
        return modPow(a, MOD - 2);
    }

    static long add(long a, long b) {
        long res = a + b;
        if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
        return res;
    }

    static long sub(long a, long b) {
        long res = a - b;
        if (res < 0) res += MOD;
        return res;
    }

    static long mul(long a, long b) {
        return (a * b) % MOD;
    }

    static long div(long a, long b) {
        return mul(a, inv(b));
    }

    static long po(int x) {
        return 1L << x;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        inv100 = inv(100);
        long[][] p = new long[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int val = sc.nextInt();
                p[i][j] = mul(val, inv100);
            }
        }

        long[] no = new long[7]; // n <= 6 assumed
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                    no[i] |= po(j);
                }
            }
        }

        HashMap<Long, Long> m = new HashMap<>();
        m.put(1L, 1L);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            HashMap<Long, Long> M = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : m.entrySet()) {
                long t = entry.getKey();
                long probBase = entry.getValue();
                for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                    long res = 0;
                    long prob = 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        if ((j & (1 << k)) != 0) {
                            prob = mul(prob, p[i][k]);
                            res |= (t & no[k]) << (1 << k);
                        } else {
                            prob = mul(prob, sub(1, p[i][k]));
                        }
                    }
                    long newKey = res;
                    long newVal = mul(probBase, prob);
                    M.put(newKey, add(M.getOrDefault(newKey, 0L), newVal));
                }
            }
            m = M;
        }

        long target = po((1 << n) - 1);
        Long ans = m.get(target);
        if (ans == null) ans = 0L;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
